dex.entry: A round pebble-sprite no larger than a fist that clings to cave walls with adhesive stone-dust feet, bouncing away when startled. Every kid will want to collect the round little pebble-thing first; it's adorable and bouncy.

art.silhouette: Almost perfectly spherical grey-brown body with two stub legs and wide amber eyes; tiny chip-marks on its shell like natural wear marks; silhouette reads as a rolling ball at 16px.
